events.speaker: customer
events.text: The washing machine in our laundry room is leaking from the front when it runs. It is still dripping now, even with the cycle paused.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: When did you first notice the problem, and does the water stop between cycles? I want to understand whether it is still happening.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: It started yesterday evening, and I saw a small puddle again this morning. No one has inspected the machine yet, and I have not tried to repair it myself.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: What appointment window would be convenient? We can note a preference for the technician, although the office will confirm the actual visit time.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Thursday morning would be easiest, preferably before eleven. I can be at home then and will make sure someone can answer the door.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Would you like the technician to provide a quote before beginning any repair work? You can also tell me a maximum budget if you have one.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Yes, please send me a quote before any work starts. I can spend up to three hundred fifty U.S. dollars total, including parts and labor.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Thanks. I have noted the appliance, the current leak, your preferred appointment, and the quote request for the repair team to review.
